note: AutoVLA (ucla-mobility): Qwen2.5-VL-3B, 3 cameras x 4 frames as video + speed / accel / command in the prompt, adaptive CoT then discrete action tokens (codebook), RFT; run as shipped through their preprocessing JSON (runner cmd)
runner_note: their eval (run_pdm_score_cot.py) feeds compute_trajectory the per-token JSON of their preprocessing (scripts/run_nuplan_preprocessing.sh, INCLUDE_COT=false, output $DATA_DIR/runs/wm_surplus/p0_autovla/navtest_nocot, built by experiments/wm_surplus/scripts/autovla_prep.py) and gets (trajectory, CoT text) back, so the generic AgentInput loop cannot run it; autovla_poses.py is that loop with their overrides
inputs: CAM_F0 / CAM_L1 / CAM_R1, 4 frames at 2 Hz each (their nuPlan mapping of front / front-left / front-right)
ego speed and acceleration magnitude in the prompt

published.source: AutoVLA paper (Zhou et al., NeurIPS 2025, arXiv 2506.13757) Table 1, NAVSIM navtest, AutoVLA post-RFT; checkpoint name AutoVLA_PDMS_89 (HF Zewei-Zhou/AutoVLA, README: merged LoRA, LORA=false)
